ml_job_overview.summary: The Process Engineer – Semiconductor Equipment at Quest Global plays a pivotal role in defining, designing, and optimising semiconductor equipment processes. This position is responsible for translating complex process requirements into robust equipment specifications, supporting the development of advanced systems, and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards. The role involves collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, conducting process simulations, and leading risk assessments to drive innovation and operational excellence. Candidates will contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering practises within a diverse and inclusive environment, making a tangible impact on the semiconductor industry’s technological advancement. Compensation and benefits are not specified in the job description.
skills: Demonstrated experience in semiconductor equipment design or advanced equipment development.
Proficiency in design using 3D CAD and the creation of engineering documentation.
Fundamental engineering knowledge in mechanics, fluid dynamics, thermal systems, and system integration.
Strong problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis and engineering troubleshooting.
Experience executing engineering projects from concept through to completion.
Preferred experience in system- or subsystem-level design beyond component-level design.
Strong communication skills suitable for a global engineering environment.
Experience managing or leading an engineering organisation or team.
responsibilities: Define process requirements and operating parameters for semiconductor equipment.
Develop Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) and Process & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) to support process design.
Establish process specifications, operating windows, and control strategies for optimal performance.
Determine critical process parameters (CPPs) and translate them into equipment design specifications.
Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, electrical, controls, and systems engineers during equipment design.
Size and select key process components, including pumps, valves, filters, piping systems, sensors, and instrumentation.
Perform mass and energy balance calculations, flow, pressure drop, thermal, and chemical analyses to model and optimise process performance.
Identify bottlenecks and capacity limitations to enhance process efficiency.
Lead or participate in HAZOP, FMEA/DFMEA, risk assessments, and process hazard analysis to ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards.
education: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field is required.

ml_job_overview.summary: The Senior Frontend Developer (React / TypeScript / Web Components) at this position will play a pivotal role in designing and developing scalable, maintainable web applications for enterprise-grade solutions. The successful candidate will focus on building reusable UI components, integrating frontend applications with backend systems, and ensuring high-quality, responsive user interfaces. Working closely with architects, UX designers, backend engineers, and DevOps teams, the role emphasises collaboration, code quality, and continuous improvement. The position requires hands-on expertise in React, TypeScript, and modern UI frameworks, with a strong emphasis on accessibility, performance, and reusable development patterns. This is an opportunity to contribute to innovative enterprise applications in a dynamic engineering environment.
skills: Demonstrated hands-on experience with React 18 and TypeScript.
Proficiency in Material UI (MUI) and Emotion, as well as HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS.
Strong knowledge of React Hooks, state management frameworks such as Zustand or equivalent, and REST API integration using Axios.
Experience with WebSockets and STOMP for real-time application communication.
Expertise in development and integration of Web Components, React Query or TanStack Query.
Ability to implement frontend authentication and authorisation using Keycloak, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect.
Familiarity with Git and GitLab, and Vite for frontend build and development.
Experience with Nx Monorepo and working with shared/multi-application frontend codebases.
Proficiency in unit and component testing using Vitest and React Testing Library.

Preferred experience in data visualisation using ECharts and/or D3.js, Storybook, Drag-and-drop UI frameworks, internationalization (i18n), multilingual application support, and exposure to Kubernetes and cloud-native application environments.
responsibilities: Design and develop scalable, maintainable web applications using React and TypeScript.
Develop reusable UI components and shared frontend libraries using Material UI (MUI), Emotion, and modern UI development practices.
Integrate frontend applications with backend systems through REST APIs, WebSockets, and STOMP-based messaging.
Design and implement Web Components and reusable UI modules that can be leveraged across multiple applications.
Build feature-rich user interfaces including dashboards, data tables, charts, forms, configuration screens, and other enterprise application workflows.
Develop responsive and accessible interfaces while ensuring good application performance and usability.
Collaborate cross-functionally with UX/UI designers, backend developers, solution architects, and DevOps teams throughout the application development lifecycle.
Participate in code reviews, unit/component testing, defect resolution, and continuous improvement of frontend solutions.
Contribute to frontend CI/CD pipelines and development standards.
Help establish and maintain reusable frontend development patterns, coding standards, and component libraries.

job.jobRequirements:
Senior Front-End Developer (React)

We are looking for an experienced Senior Front-End Developer to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of modern, scalable web applications. The role will focus on building enterprise-grade user interfaces using React and TypeScript, developing reusable UI components, and integrating applications with backend and real-time services.

The candidate will work closely with architects, UX designers, backend engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality, maintainable, and responsive applications.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable, maintainable web applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Develop reusable UI components and shared frontend libraries using Material UI (MUI), Emotion, and modern UI development practices.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend systems through REST APIs, WebSockets, and STOMP-based messaging.
  • Design and implement Web Components and reusable UI modules that can be leveraged across multiple applications.
  • Build feature-rich user interfaces including dashboards, data tables, charts, forms, configuration screens, and other enterprise application workflows.
  • Develop responsive and accessible interfaces while ensuring good application performance and usability.
  • Work closely with UX/UI designers, backend developers, solution architects, and DevOps teams throughout the application development lifecycle.
  • Participate in code reviews, unit/component testing, defect resolution, and continuous improvement of frontend solutions.
  • Contribute to frontend CI/CD pipelines and development standards.
  • Help establish and maintain reusable frontend development patterns, coding standards, and component libraries.

Mandatory Technical Skills:

Candidates should have strong hands-on experience with the following:

  • React 18 and TypeScript
  • Material UI (MUI) and Emotion
  • HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS
  • React Hooks and state management frameworks such as Zustand or equivalent
  • REST API integration, preferably using Axios
  • WebSockets and STOMP for real-time application communication
  • Development and integration of Web Components
  • React Query / TanStack Query
  • Frontend authentication and authorization using Keycloak, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect
  • Git and GitLab
  • Vite for frontend build and development
  • Nx Monorepo and experience working with shared/multi-application frontend codebases
  • Unit and component testing using Vitest and React Testing Library

Good to Have:

Experience in any of the following areas will be an added advantage:

  • Data visualization using ECharts and/or D3.js
  • Storybook for component development and documentation
  • Drag-and-drop UI frameworks and libraries
  • Internationalization (i18n) and multilingual application support
  • Experience in Industrial IoT, Asset Management, Energy, or similar industrial domains
  • Exposure to Kubernetes and cloud-native application environments

The candidate will work closely with architects, UX designers, backend engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality, maintainable, and responsive applications.

  • Integrate frontend applications with backend systems through REST APIs, WebSockets, and STOMP-based messaging.
  • Design and implement Web Components and reusable UI modules that can be leveraged across multiple applications.
  • Build feature-rich user interfaces including dashboards, data tables, charts, forms, configuration screens, and other enterprise application workflows.
  • Develop responsive and accessible interfaces while ensuring good application performance and usability.
  • Work closely with UX/UI designers, backend developers, solution architects, and DevOps teams throughout the application development lifecycle.
  • Participate in code reviews, unit/component testing, defect resolution, and continuous improvement of frontend solutions.
  • Contribute to frontend CI/CD pipelines and development standards.
  • Help establish and maintain reusable frontend development patterns, coding standards, and component libraries.

Mandatory Technical Skills:

Candidates should have strong hands-on experience with the following:

  • React 18 and TypeScript
  • Material UI (MUI) and Emotion
  • HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS
  • React Hooks and state management frameworks such as Zustand or equivalent

Experience in any of the following areas will be an added advantage:
